Pitch Trajectory

  • CURIE: gmeow:PitchTrajectory
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchTrajectory
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

Continuous pitch as content — an ordered set of control points (musical-time × PitchValue) plus an interpolation kind. Models glissandi, gamaka ornaments, UPIC curves, and other continuously varying pitch (stress case 6). Interpolation is solver-evaluated, never reasoner-asserted (Principle 12).

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Entity, gufo:Object

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:PitchTrajectory as a specialized kind of gmeow:Entity, gufo:Object. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
